reply.text:
I can't give you a safe amount or a safe combination, since that's dosing, and it's one for a doctor or a dietitian. What I can say in general terms is that most pre-workouts lean on caffeine and other stimulants, so doubling up means stacking those, and the labels are written for one serving, not two. A doctor or pharmacist can tell you what's right for you, especially if you take any medication or have a heart or blood pressure concern.

On the training side, sleep, a proper warm-up and a good meal beforehand do a lot of the work a pre-workout claims to. If your sessions feel flat, tell me how they've been going and we can look at what's behind it.
